div.l: She was a worthi woman / all here lyve
Husbondes at the chirche dore / she hadde had fyve
Wythoute othir companye / in youthe
But therof nedeth nowt / to speke as nouthe
And thryes hadde ben / at Ierusalem
She hadde passed / many a strong strem
At Rome she hadde be / and at Boleyne
In Galis / at seint Ianys and at coleyne
She cowde moche / of wandryng bi the weye
Cat tothed was she / sothly for to seye
Vp on an amblere / esely she sat
Wel I wympeled / and on here hed an hat
As brood as is a bokeler / or a targe
A foot mantyl / aboute here hepys large
And on here feet / a peire spores sharpe
In felawshepe wel cowde she / lawhe and carpe
Of remedies of love / she knewe ꝑperchaunce
For she cowde of that art / tholde daunce
A Good man was ther / of religion Person
And was a pore ꝑperson of a toun
But Riche he was / of holy thouht and werk
He was also / a lerned men a clerk
That cristys gospell / treuly wold preche
His paryshenys / devoutly wold he teche
Benygne / he was / and wondir diligent
And in aduersite / wol pacyent
And suche he was p̉erved / oft sythes
For sothe he was / to cursen for his tythes
But rather wold he yeven / out of dowte
Vnto his pore paryshonys / a boute
Of his offryng / and of his sustinaunce
He coude in litel thinges / haue suffisaunce
Wide was his paryshe and housis fer assondir
